name: PT Sunson Textile Manufacturer Tbk
summary: PT Sunson Textile Manufacturer Tbk manufactures and sells yarn, fabric, and other textile products in Indonesia. The company operates in three segments: Spinning, Weaving, and Others. It provides yarn and woven fabric made from cotton, TC, CVC, TR, PE, and DTY polyester yarns. The company is also involved in general trading activities. In addition, it exports its products. PT Sunson Textile Manufacturer Tbk was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Bandung, Indonesia.
